definitions.explanation: Something that has recently come into existence or prominence; newly established and growing.

examples.japanese: {新興|しんこう}⟦{国|こく}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{著|いちじる}しい→著しい：noentry⟧。
examples.english: The economic growth of emerging nations is remarkable.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新興|しんこう}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}した→開発する：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is a product developed by a startup company.

examples.japanese: {新興|しんこう}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦{地|ち}→地：09852_chi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved to a newly developed residential area.

notes:
{新興|しんこう} describes things that are newly established and on the rise. It often has positive connotations of growth and development.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {新興|しんこう}{国|こく}: emerging nation/country
- {新興|しんこう}{企業|きぎょう}: startup, emerging company
- {新興|しんこう}{住宅|じゅうたく}{地|ち}: newly developed residential area
- {新興|しんこう}{勢力|せいりょく}: rising power/force
- {新興|しんこう}{宗教|しゅうきょう}: new religion

NOTE: This is a homophone with {信仰|しんこう} (faith) and {進行|しんこう} (progress).
